name: Glendo State Park (Soldier Rock Campground)
inclusion_evidence: reserve.wyoming.gov (US eDirect API wyordr.usedirect.com/wyomingrdr/rdr/, PlaceId 10 'Glendo State Park', FacilityId 346 'Soldier Rock', facility point 42.49184722,-104.97069444, read 2026-11-20): 8 web-bookable 'Campsite Non-Electric' SR03, SR04, SR06, SR08-SR12 (no SR01/02/05/07 units; IsRVSite true; Rate 10.00; MaximumStay 14; all Back In; 'Parking Pad Material: None'; 'Tent Pad Surface: No tent pad(natural ground)'; 'Unit & Parking Size(ft)': SR06 65, SR04 55, SR08/SR09 45, SR03 40, SR12 35, SR10/SR11 30; 'Shade: Partial'; 'Waterfront Setting: Reservoir' on every unit, type-level). Park text (search-result text of page 1709, The Dyrt and Campflare copies, 2026-11-20): 'three small sections along Lakeshore Drive'; 'fairly primitive, without gravel camping and/or parking pads'; 'A single vault toilet serves the campground'; no running water; reservations May 15 - Sep 15, first-come otherwise, open year-round. Not in the DB: no 'Soldier Rock' name match; unit centroid 42.49048,-104.97331 is ~0.7 km S of 13977 Reno Cove (FacilityId 341, units RC02-RC21 at 42.4965-42.4979), ~0.85 km NE of 13969 Custer Cove (FacilityId 336) and ~1.3 km S of 15742 Red Hills (FacilityId 340) - each a separate engine facility. Fails on access: agency 4WD recommendation (see why).
flags: Skipped on the park's own unconditional 4WD recommendation ('for anyone planning to camp in Soldier Rock'); unlike Red Hills (15742), where the wording covered one spur, it covers the whole campground, and all three sections are reached by the 'narrow and poorly developed' access roads off Lakeshore Drive. Corroborated by a 2025-10-29 Dyrt review ('Horrible roads'): 'as soon as you get past the bathroom the dirt roads around the camp are steep and washed out ... I spun my van tires going up the hill to get out ... Avoid unless you have suv or truck'. The Dyrt's own overview (not park text) says 'high-clearance vehicles strongly recommended'.

If AWH confirms 2WD access, the add data is here: 8 natural-ground back-in non-electric sites, 30-65 ft parking (all fit a 23-ft rig), $10 base on the Glendo schedule (as 13969 Custer Cove / 6352 Two Moon), one vault toilet, no water, reservations May 15 - Sep 15 (engine and park text), park open year-round; pin at the unit centroid above (the engine facility point sits ~300 m NE at the east end, by SR10-SR12). Waterfront not audited (skip); every unit carries the engine's type-level 'Reservoir' tag and the park says 'Each area provides good access to the water' - an add would need the full-pool lidar/imagery audit.
